title: The yard of Node Beta Industrial Station finishes our first Recursion: 8 sensor arrays and 5 void condensate bought at Sol, 47 silicate composite at Sirius and Synchrony, sold into the yard's bids on a Voidborn trader's way home
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 12:40 UTC (requests.log ENT-438, Apophis: yes; orders ENT-082, block MERCURY; rules F12, F23, F19). The Recursion commissioned at 00:27 UTC (354,427 cr paid) reads SOURCING for these three goods, whose only bids stand at Node Beta (table books 12:25 UTC): sensor_array 906 x 8, silicate_composite 435 x 47, void_condensate 439 x 5. Asks (12:25 UTC): sensor_array 888 x 4,886 and void_condensate 929 x 50 at Sol; silicate_composite 412 x 10 at Sirius (then 723; view_market 12:27 UTC) and 531 x 3,901 at Synchrony. Bought about 35,900 cr, sold about 29,900: a loss of about 6,000 cr for the fleet's first tier-2 warship (the fleet is one purse, F19). The goods are bought for the yard and never enter the reserve's stock (they are open needs of the Recursion batch, rule F24: no stock is sold). One unit first of each good (F12), then the rest, stop_on_failed_buy at Sol. Road: Alpha Centauri - Sol - Sirius - Nova Terra - Furud - Homam - Antares - GSC-0041 - Pherkad - Synchrony - Node Alpha - Node Beta, 11 jumps, the Form TA-1 road home. One pilot, once.
